candidates.description: This vector activates for Devanagari characters containing the retroflex sibilant consonant 'ष' (ṣa) with various vowel matras and conjuncts.
This vector activates for tokens containing the Devanagari letter 'भ' (bha) or similar Indic script fragments.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi pronouns, personal prefixes, and related grammatical morphemes.
This feature vector is related to common sub-word tokens, prefixes, and syllables in the Hindi Devanagari script.
This vector activates for various Hindi vowel signs, consonant conjuncts, and sub-syllabic Devanagari character fragments.
This vector activates for common Hindi and Devanagari word suffixes and letters.
These tokens represent Hindi verbal suffixes indicating tense, aspect, and gender agreement.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel matras and character suffixes used in Devanagari script tokenization.
This vector is related to common subword suffixes and characters in the Devanagari script.
This vector is related to Hindi script characters, vowel signs, and common word fragments.
